target: scaffold.sh status — a stamp separates an untouched old copy (stale) from a local edit (modified)
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.9.0; scaffold_put fake/scripts/lib/tracker.sh NEW; scaffold_put fake/scripts/lib/common.sh NEW; scaffold_put scripts/lib/tracker.sh OLD; scaffold_put scripts/lib/common.sh OLD; scaffold_fake_stamp "$SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH" 0.8.0 software-interviewed scripts/lib/tracker.sh scripts/lib/common.sh; scaffold_put scripts/lib/common.sh HAND_EDITED; scaffold_status fake software-interviewed | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0)) | map(split("\t")) | map({(.[0]): .[1]}) | add'
